hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional palette (Tableau10 shuffled, slate edge lines) and clean card UI show design awareness, but the dense control panel with FPS counter and elastic/back easing params tips it into tech-demo territory, and the overall composition lacks the restraint or typographic hierarchy needed to score higher.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correctly uses scaleSqrt for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains (d3.extent, root.height), and key functions in all data joins; no bar/area baseline violations, dual-axis fabrication, or silent-gap issues apply to this topology-first visualization.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension-slider fires full redrawLinks() on every input event without RAF/debounce (300 links × DOM mutation per pixel), and layout transitions lack .interrupt() calls so the orphaned force-layout path transition conflicts with any subsequent layout switch, risking snap artifacts mid-flight.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single active view with edge bundling and progressive-disclosure hover/click keeps 200-node, 300-edge complexity manageable, but the central bundle convergence forms a dense tangle that resists at-a-glance parsing, and the 8 layout buttons plus 4 view controls plus easing panel add non-trivial UI overhead.
